Creating a project with no description succeeds; details page renders '-' placeholder
Editing and clearing a set description sends clear_description:true
Editing without touching description leaves value unchanged

standards_review.notes: No introduced complexity; follows existing clear_display_name pattern.
No HTML sinks, redirects, secrets, or auth touched.

rationale: Multi-lens review of a small (~200-line) diff. Blind lens raised speculative concerns about mutually-exclusive flag combinations and null coercion; edge-case lens confirmed the actual code paths in ProjectModal.handleFormSubmit and store.updateProject satisfy the backend contract (description+clear_description never sent together from the modal, whitespace correctly maps to clear on edit, no-op on create). Acceptance lens flagged AC8 (missing ProjectDetailsPage null-fixture test) as failing — resolved inline by adding the test before assembling the verdict. One acknowledged pattern: createProject spreads ProjectFormData via `...data`, so `clear_description:false` is included in the POST body — this mirrors the pre-existing behavior for clear_display_name/clear_cost_center which the backend already tolerates on POST. Not a blocker; no code change made. 3 dismissed (speculative), 1 patched inline (AC8 test), 0 deferred. Confidence medium: every lens ran with parseable output; no ambiguity remains.
